page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-96-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-intensive server instance. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The system features a 504 MB L3 cache and is equipped with 744 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 16 local NVMe SSDs that deliver a total capacity of 6167 GB.

In benchmark evaluations, this instance demonstrates top-tier performance across multiple domains. It achieves top 10% placement in Passmark CPU scores, Passmark database operations, and Redis SET operations, where it processes 170.8 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth for small-block cached reads also ranks in the top 10%, reaching 7676.9 GB/sec, while large-block uncached reads operate at a strong 356.43 GB/sec. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and software compilation with Clang both register in the top 10% tier. For language model workloads, prompt processing with a medium 7B model achieves top-tier speeds of 315.02 tokens per second, though text generation for large 70B models is more moderate at 4.69 tokens per second.

The high density of dedicated compute cores, large memory capacity, and substantial local NVMe storage provides high qualitative cost efficiency for resource-intensive enterprise workloads. This hardware profile is highly suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, software compilation pipelines, and high-throughput web serving. The lack of a dedicated GPU makes it less optimal for heavy model training, but its advanced vector and matrix extensions support efficient CPU-based inference and cryptographic tasks.

The combination of dense memory, dedicated compute, and high-speed local storage makes it highly efficient for demanding workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching, and high-throughput web serving, though the absence of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training.
